pool: Same 15 clips; 800 source-PTS samples; historic G/F replay; R0/R1 references.
local: Frozen IF-03 G regions, 4x4, IF-01 measure, old HSV<=0.50 prefilter, quality>=8, local competitive margin 0.12, two peeling rounds. Geometry failure, prefilter and missing cache never become negative presence.

alternatives.rank: Descending number of historical direct positive 0.8s windows, then number of direct positive samples, then source index. No label or anchor-times.
alternatives.admission: Same 4x4 regional bank and G grouping; individual alternative group needs >=2 exclusive positive windows against the union of all C0 competitors and other groups in same alternate; reject near duplicates as witnesses (HSV<=.04 and gray<=.02); reject window Jaccard >.50 with any active incumbent. Rank per alternate by exclusive bins descending then group ID. Admit once in reference rank order subject to capacity. A whole alternative is considered only when it has no two qualifying internal groups. Do not remove old G IDs or have an alternative whole and its children vote together.
alternatives.fallback: A verified, available empty intervention is still C1. Only on cache/detector integrity or technical failure before C1 locks use C0 for that case, record failure; never choose using accuracy. No reference shortage authorizes new detector or unbounded pair computation.

hsv.metric: Frozen v05 global matrix, P1.4 L1 HSV [18,8,8], Hellinger distance; recheck calculation on original RGB.
hsv.template_policy: Exclusive direct L positive frames excluding all catalogue anchors and near duplicates of rivals. Distinct 0.8s windows. Use observed-medoid window reps, first medoid and deterministic farthest-first; reject near-duplicate templates. Require exclusive witnesses in two distinct windows before deduplication. Repeated color views can collapse to one template and never increase the vote count. Mixed anchor's whole-image HSV is shared context only. Candidate-scoped self exclusion and query-origin flags. No probability, promotion or score average. H checks all active identities independently from per-query L/old pre-gate.
hsv.near_duplicate: HSV<=0.04 and gray<=0.02; never count repeated views as extra votes; retained per-template diagnostics; min distance only

fusion: L winner retained high if H agrees or has no winner. Different winners => conflict abstention. Ambiguous but positive L never resolved by H alone. HSV-only unique winner when L has no positives => medium tentative. H-only arm also medium, so old reliable occurrence gate excludes color-only midpoint anchors; refined cells and original selector still see the tentative assignments. LH downstream distance curves use original L scores; H curves use HSV. All positives persist separately from main assignment.
evaluation: Read labels only after all predictions. Fair union excludes all references, generation witness samples (including historic C0/F), and HSV templates actually used; show all reviewed and ref/template excluded development metrics when strict split shrinks. No holdout claim or sweep. Report stable vs changed, both channels, full overlap and errors. No optional gray fusion or new model.
stop: One run per arm, freeze and report observed failures and unknowns.
